page_title: NIC 6-0 BRE | Nice v Brest 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+6' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+4' 6 - 0 Goal! Ali Abdi (Nice) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 6:0.
90+2' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Mama Balde (Brest) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Antoine Mendy (Nice) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
86' Mama Balde (Brest) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
85' Here is a change. Jonathan Clauss is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Ali Abdi (Nice).
83' Substitution. Mama Balde (Brest) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ludovic Ajorque walks off.
82' 5 - 0 Terem Moffi (Nice) runs on to a clever pass from Sofiane Diop and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
80' Substitution. Pierre Lees-Melou leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
80' That will be all from Evann Guessand who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Terem Moffi (Nice).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Massadio Haidara (Brest) comes onto the pitch for Bradley Locko.
78' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Morgan Sanson (Nice) replaces Gaetan Laborde.
77' Evann Guessand (Nice) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
75' 4 - 0 Gaetan Laborde (Nice) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the middle of the goal.
74' Antoine Mendy (Nice) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem no option but to blow his whistle.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
69' Baptiste Santamaria will be replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
69' The game has come to an end for Badredine Bouanani. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sofiane Diop (Nice).
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brest, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Mathias Pereira Lage and he is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Brest).
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Romain Del Castillo (Brest) coming on for Kamory Doumbia.
64' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' The referee has issued a yellow card to Hugo Magnetti (Brest).
61' Bradley Locko (Brest) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.

58' Nice move, nice attempt! Badredine Bouanani (Nice) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.

56' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Bizot shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
54' Melvin Bard (Nice) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
50' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) sees a yellow card from Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' The whistle blows and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A clever short pass gives Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
40' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
38' Mahdi Camara (Brest) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
37' Antoine Mendy (Nice) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
33' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows the yellow card to Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) for a heavy challenge.
30' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
28' 3 - 0 Goal! Badredine Bouanani (Nice) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Bizot into the bottom right corner.
27' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' A yellow card for a tackle by Bradley Locko (Brest). Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
26' The rebound from the corner kick falls to Melvin Bard (Nice), who sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. Fine strike, but it lacks accuracy and goes wide of the goal.
22' He should have scored! Evann Guessand (Nice) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
21' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' 2 - 0 Goal! Evann Guessand puts the ball across the area and Gaetan Laborde (Nice) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:0.
16' 1 - 0 Evann Guessand (Nice) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the middle of the goal.
14' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonathan Clauss (Nice). Good work from Nice as they win a corner.
13' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post.
11' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.
8' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Marcin Bulka makes a save to deny the long-range effort from Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) towards the middle of the goal.
4' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
3' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Nice force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee signals a corner kick to Nice.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
